mapper.select: SELECT rp.role_seq, rp.perm_seq, rp.action_code, rp.data_scope, r.role_id, p.perm_id, p.module_code, COALESCE(rp.data_scope, r.default_data_scope) AS effective_data_scope FROM tb_role_permission rp JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = rp.role_seq JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_seq = rp.perm_seq WHERE rp.role_seq = #{roleSeq} ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.perm_id, rp.action_code

SELECT p.perm_seq, p.perm_id, p.perm_name, p.module_code, p.use_yn, (SELECT string_agg(a.action_code, ',' ORDER BY a.action_code) FROM tb_permission_action a WHERE a.perm_seq = p.perm_seq) AS actions FROM tb_permission p WHERE p.perm_id IN
#{permId}
